name: analyze_user_selection
description: Analyze user input to determine which profile option they are selecting from a list of numbered options, or detect registration intent

selected_option.description: The option number the user selected (1, 2, 3, etc.) or null if unclear

reasoning.description: Explanation of why this option was selected and the analysis process

alternative_matches.description: Other possible option numbers that could match the user input

requires_clarification.description: Whether the input is too ambiguous and requires user clarification

type.description: Registration type detected: 'buyer' if user wants to register as buyer, 'seller' if user wants to register as seller, null if no registration intent detected

register.description: Registration intent detection. Return {"type": "buyer"} if user mentions 'register me as buyer', {"type": "seller"} if user mentions 'register me as seller', {"type": null} if no registration intent
